logo_clause: Use ONLY the white mark from image 1 (curved swoosh joined to a diagonal stroke, plus a round dot) with its exact shape and proportions. Do not copy the background: no square, no badge, no sticker, no patch, no other text or logos.

branded_examples.hoodie_back: iPhone photo from behind of a person in a black hoodie walking in a park at sunrise, face not visible. The white mark from image 1 is screen-printed large on the back, fabric texture showing through, following the folds.
